name: platform-stack
description: Capability cards beside a numbered index that tracks the card being read: tinted cards with title, copy, link, a product screenshot and a hover preview. Live: the homepage #ap-platform-stack-v3 section (markup and sheets ported).

items.description: Cards, in order. Each: title and body (required); anchor (card id the index links to and live keys colour by, e.g. ap-card-lifecycle), nav_label (index text, e.g. "01 Asset Management"), tone (custom, gold, pink, green), link_tone (purple, gold, pink, green), link_label, link_url, image / image_alt / image_w / image_h (screenshot), image_hover / image_hover_alt / hover_w / hover_h (hover preview), hover_slot (1-7, the preview's placement), hover_bg (image swapped in behind the preview), visual_custom (first card's wider visual). The word UrsaAI is styled as the brand mark.
